dataModeDemoText: Uses unverified demo values for interface testing only.
dataModeSourceCandidateReviewText: Uses source-candidate values in public-review calculations. They are not promoted or verified runtime data.
dataModePromotedRuntimeText: Reserved for data that has passed the explicit promotion gate for runtime use.
denominatorRetailElectricitySales: annual retail electricity sales to ultimate customers
truthBoundaryEuSourceCandidate: Eurostat annual final electricity consumption is used as a source candidate. It is not promoted or verified runtime data.
truthBoundaryUsSourceCandidate: EIA retail electricity sales to ultimate customers are used as a source candidate; direct use is excluded. The value is not promoted or verified runtime data.
truthBoundaryWorldSourceCandidate: UNSD 2023 world total final electricity consumption is used as a source candidate. It is not promoted or verified runtime data.
beyondTotalIntro: Above 100%, this is not an allocation. It compares the scenario's required annual energy with the full annual electricity denominator.
requiredEnergySentenceTemplate: {profiles} configured AI-worker profiles would require {twh} TWh/year, equivalent to {energyMultiple} times {countryName}'s {denominator}. This is a beyond-total-electricity thought experiment, not an allocation.
sourceCandidateReportBoundary: Source-candidate values are used in review calculations. They are not promoted or verified runtime data.
energyBoundary: energy-equivalent scenario capacity - not spare grid capacity or deployment prediction
calculationBasisPrecise: calculation basis uses this precise value
calculationBasisStatus: watts x hours/week x weeks/year x overhead
fullOutputAssumption: reference assumption: energy equivalent at continuous 3 MW nameplate output; not a realistic turbine count
nuclearAssumption: reference assumption: 1 GW reactor at 90% capacity factor
hydroAssumption: reference assumption: 500 MW hydro plant at 45% capacity factor
truthBoundaryText: Outputs are energy-equivalent scenarios only. They do not show spare electricity or grid capacity, deployed AI workers, or job loss. Data status is shown separately by mode.
workerIntro: Set the watt profile and runtime used for this scenario.
publicReviewPdfBoundary: Public-review scenario report. Not spare grid capacity. Not a deployment prediction.
scenarioSettingsBoundary: These are scenario settings, not a prediction.
allocationIntro: How much of this country's {denominator} is allocated to AI labour?
allocationSentenceTemplate: Allocating {share} of {countryName}'s {denominator} to this scenario would provide an equivalent yearly energy budget for {profiles} configured AI-worker profiles.
comparisonSentenceTemplate: Comparison: {profiles} configured profiles would require {twh} TWh/year, or {share} of {countryName}'s {denominator}.
calculationBasisTemplate: {watts} W x {hoursPerWeek} h/week x {weeksPerYear} weeks/year x {overhead} overhead = {mwhYear} MWh/profile/year
